{{Quote|This was his place of power&mdash;You are nothing here!|The Prophet of Vodal Kressh|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Tomb of Vodal Kressh''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]] for the [[Sith alchemist/Legends|Sith alchemist]] [[Vodal Kressh]]. Those who had served Kressh during his life remained on Athiss in the tomb and their descendants became known as the [[Tomb Dwellers]]. When [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic survey team six-eight-nine-mark-one|survey team six-eight-nine-mark-one]] landed on Athiss they accidentally discovered the tomb and were driven mad before being attacked by the Dwellers. Both the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] then put together strike teams to investigate the area where the survey team had gone missing, and one of the strike teams arrived at the tomb and [[Mission to Athiss|fought]] their way through the guardians and disciples with in before reaching the [[Prophet of Vodal Kressh]], leader of the dwellers. The team fought and killed the prophet and then recovered a group of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] located in the tomb.<ref name="TOR" />

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] thousands of years later, it was rumored that the Republic had destroyed Kressh and his followers, but that a dark cult still protected his tomb.<ref name="FaD CRB">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
